what_this_is: W1.1 faithful fWAR replica scored component by component against the published StatsAPI sabermetrics feed (FanGraphs' WAR line)

gate.rule: a component clears a season when >= 99% of its rows sit within 1.0 run

built: positional (FG ladder, DH from B-Ref Inn, pitcher-batting credit)
consumed: batting park factor (LOO back-solve from feed Batting)
pitching park factor (LOO back-solve from feed FIP-)
war_runs_note: war_runs is (replica WAR - feed WAR) times the season RPW, so both sides are gated in runs

framing.source: rar minus the six published components, kept for players with catcher innings

park_factor.method: leave-one-out back-solve from feed Batting, PA-weighted over single-team hitters with PA >= 30
leave-one-out back-solve from feed FIP-, IP-weighted over single-team pitchers with IP >= 20
